name: Makihara Shinji
source:
He is Eri’s brother-in-law and attends college in the neighboring town.
He has an ongoing physical relationship with his sister-in-law, Eri, and is being trained as a masochist.
Although he has been trained to be submissive toward women, his suppressed masculine instincts begin to surface after he has a relationship with Rumi.
